info.title: MOTOCAST Android place search contract
info.description: Backward-compatible keyword search plus coordinate reverse lookup with an opt-in region-only fallback (1.2.0). Keyword unknown fields remain ignored; coordinate mode rejects every extra field except the optional fallback. Runtime string limits use UTF-16 units and ECMAScript whitespace normalization. Fixed candidates and live readiness are recorded separately.

servers.description: Production only after verified compatible deployment

post.summary: Resolve signed places as an active member within the existing Local quota

projectKey.description: Public project key only; never a service-role or secret key.

query.description: 2-100 UTF-16 units AFTER ECMAScript whitespace normalization. These post-normalization limits intentionally are not raw JSON Schema minLength/maxLength.

fallback.description: Optional (1.2.0). Only when coord2address returns no document, the server spends one more unit of the same local_keyword_search daily budget and calls coord2regioncode once. Any other value, including null, is INVALID_PLACE_SEARCH_REQUEST.

CoordinateSearchRequest.description: Round coordinates to 7 decimal places before provider call and signing. No automatic retry. Response is zero or one place, isEnd=true. Coordinates are never snapped to a different place. Without fallback (1.1.0 behaviour): one budget unit, one coord2address call; an address yields kakaoPlaceId map:<lat7>:<lng7>, otherwise places=[]. With fallback="region" and no address: a second budget unit is charged before one coord2regioncode call. Exactly one region_type B document is used (B/H in any order); no B document yields places=[]; two or more B documents, more than ten documents or a malformed document is INVALID_PLACE_PROVIDER_RESPONSE (502). A refused second charge, a lost charge response, a timeout, a provider 4xx/5xx or invalid JSON is an error with no retry or refund and is never reported as an empty result. A region place has kakaoPlaceId map:<lat7>:<lng7>:region, address = B address_name, roadAddress = null, name = "<region_2depth_name> <region_3depth_name> 부근" (the available parts, or the address when both are empty), category = "지도에서 선택 · 상세 주소 없음", phone = null, placeUrl = null, the selected coordinate, and a signature over that identity. Strings are trimmed and control characters are rejected before signing. Client check: a request without fallback accepts only kakaoPlaceId map:<lat7>:<lng7>; a request with fallback accepts exactly map:<lat7>:<lng7> or map:<lat7>:<lng7>:region. Both require the selected rounded coordinate, at most one place and isEnd=true; any other coordinate or suffix is rejected. Saving a :region place requires a non-null alias (INVALID_SAVED_PLACE_METADATA).
